info.title: QVeris Public REST API
info.summary: External REST API for enterprise integration.
info.description: OpenAPI 3.1 schema for the formally released public `/api/v1` REST API surface. It covers search, provider discovery, tool metadata lookup/execution, credits, and account audit endpoints. Unreleased API families are intentionally excluded from this customer-facing schema.

post.summary: Issue or exchange an OAuth token
post.description: Supports Authorization Code, Refresh Token, Device Code, and RFC 8693 Token Exchange. Token Exchange requires HTTP Basic authentication for a registered confidential Agent Runtime. Its subject_token, subject_token_type, resource, and scope fields are required together. Delegation tokens have a maximum 600-second lifetime and never include a refresh_token.

PublicApiMetadata.title: PublicApiMetadata
PublicApiMetadata.description: Unauthenticated metadata used by API clients for compatibility checks.

schema_hash.description: SHA-256 identity of the published CAP contract.

max_credits.description: Maximum credits allowed for this execution. Candidates without a provable upper bound are excluded.

schema_hash.description: SHA-256 identity of the published CAP contract.

query.description: Natural-language capability query or an exact tool ID for deterministic lookup.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked results to return.

session_id.description: Optional tracking and pricing-context identifier. It does not promise a cache hit.

view.description: Response projection. `routing` returns compact routing cards (`tool_id`, `capability`, `cost_class`, `reliability`, `as_of_support`) sized for model context; `full` or omitted returns the complete result shape, byte-identical to previous releases.

lang.description: Response language. When omitted the service negotiates from the `Accept-Language` header.

search_id.description: Search id that returned these capabilities, when available.

session_id.description: Optional tracking and pricing-context identifier. It does not promise a cache hit.

view.description: Response projection. `lean` trims per-capability metadata for model context; `full` or omitted returns the complete result shape.

parameters.description: Candidate parameters to validate without executing the capability.

live_budget.description: M1 is zero-cost; every value avoids an upstream tool execution.

tool_id.description: Capability id. Optional when supplied as the `tool_id` query parameter.

search_id.description: Search id that returned the selected capability.

session_id.description: Optional tracking and pricing-context identifier. If omitted, the service may use the execution id.

parameters.description: Capability-specific parameters validated by the selected tool schema.

max_response_size.description: Maximum response payload bytes before truncation. Use -1 for no limit.

respond_with.description: Server-side result projection. `full` (default) returns the complete result, byte-identical to previous releases. `fields:<JSONPath,...>` returns only the selected fields — JSONPath expressions are rooted at `result.data`, comma-separated, and at least one non-empty expression is required. `summary` returns the response schema, size/row statistics, and a `full_content_file_url` for the complete payload.

PublicBillingRule.title: PublicBillingRule
PublicBillingRule.description: Capability billing rule used for pre-call estimation. Final settlement is reflected in usage audit and credits ledger endpoints.

PublicCapabilityTag.title: PublicCapabilityTag
PublicCapabilityTag.description: Coverage tag attached to a capability descriptor (e.g. market coverage).

PublicToolCapability.title: PublicToolCapability
PublicToolCapability.description: Standardized capability descriptor attached to a capability result (e.g. MKT.BARS.ADJUSTED with market coverage tags).

categories.description: Categories/tags attached to the capability. Current responses return category objects; legacy responses returned plain strings.

capabilities.description: Standardized capability descriptors with coverage tags.

why_recommended.description: Human-readable explanation of why this capability was recommended for the query. Returned by Discover.

expected_cost.description: Pre-call cost estimate returned by Discover/Inspect when available.

cost.description: Legacy cost estimate. Prefer `expected_cost` and `billing_rule` for pre-call display.

capability.description: Compact capability summary. Returned instead of the full descriptor fields when the request sets `view: routing`.

cost_class.description: Coarse cost tier (e.g. `low`). Returned by the `routing` view.

reliability.description: Coarse reliability grade (e.g. `A`). Returned by the `routing` view.

as_of_support.description: Whether the capability supports as-of/point-in-time queries. Returned by the `routing` view.

respond_with.description: Echo of the requested projection mode when `respond_with` was set (e.g. `summary`).

summary.description: Size and shape statistics returned by the `summary` projection.

result.description: Capability result. Projected responses use the documented object shape; default/full responses may contain any JSON value.

details.description: Field-level validation failures. Present when a request parameter or projection such as `respond_with` is invalid.

OAuthClientBasic.description: HTTP Basic client authentication. Required for Token Exchange and Introspection; supported by confidential clients on Device Authorization and Revocation.
